metadata.description: Approved Claude Code plugins for Pixida (hooks, agents, skills). Central, MR-reviewed source of truth so hooks stay locked to a reviewed channel.

plugins.name: notify-sound
plugins.description: Cross-platform completion sound played when Claude finishes a turn (Stop hook). Opt-in. Silence per-user with CLAUDE_HOOK_SOUND=off.

plugins.name: notify-attention
plugins.description: Cross-platform attention sound played when Claude needs the user (Notification hook: permission, idle, input requested). Opt-in. Silence per-user with CLAUDE_HOOK_SOUND=off.
